publisher: Beijing Internet Court / 北京互联网法院
title: An actor appears in a short drama
zhTitle: 未参演的演员出现在短剧中
summary: The court reported an AI face-swap dispute in a Chinese short drama. It found both the producer and distributor liable. A copyright licence for the drama did not clear the actor’s likeness rights.
zhSummary: 北京互联网法院公布了一起中国短剧 AI 换脸纠纷。法院认定制作方和播出方侵害肖像权。播出方取得了短剧著作权授权，但这不等于取得演员的肖像许可。
question: Who approved this new role?
zhQuestion: 这个新角色经过谁的同意？

publisher: Civil Code, Articles 1021–1022 / 民法典第1021–1022条
title: Permission has a scope
summary: China’s Civil Code addresses interpretation and termination of likeness licences. An unclear term can be terminated with reasonable notice. A fixed term may also be terminated for justified reasons, subject to notice and possible compensation. The auction contract here is fictional.
zhSummary: 《民法典》规定了肖像许可条款的解释和解除。期限未约定或不明确时，可提前合理通知后解除。期限明确时，有正当理由也可解除，但涉及通知和可能的赔偿。本项目中的拍卖合同是虚构的。
question: Which uses would you permit, and for how long?
zhQuestion: 你允许哪些用途？允许多久？

publisher: China Court Network via Zhongshan Court / 中国法院网、中山法院网
title: A portrait becomes a reusable template
zhTitle: 肖像成为可重复使用的模板
summary: A blogger’s videos were used without permission as face-swap templates. The report records a first-instance infringement finding and a later appeal settlement. This was a short-video case, not a short-drama sale or a voluntary likeness licence.
zhSummary: 博主赵某的视频未经同意被用作换脸模板。报道记载了一审侵权判决和后续二审调解。这是短视频再利用案例，不是短剧交易，也不是自愿出售肖像授权的案例。
question: Can you control copies made after permission ends?
zhQuestion: 授权结束后，已生成的副本还能被控制吗？

publisher: Supreme People’s Court / 最高人民法院
title: Changing a face does not clear video rights
zhTitle: 换一张脸，仍涉及原视频权利
summary: The Supreme People’s Court included an AI face-swap copyright dispute in its 2024 typical intellectual property cases. A platform reused original videos as face-swap material. The court found infringement of the creator’s right of communication through information networks. This concerns video copyright, not a voluntary likeness sale.
zhSummary: 最高人民法院公布的2024年知识产权典型案例包括一起 AI 换脸著作权纠纷。平台将他人原始视频用于换脸服务，法院认定其侵害创作者的作品信息网络传播权。这涉及视频著作权，不是自愿出售肖像的案例。
question: Who owns the footage around a replaced face?
zhQuestion: 脸被替换后，原来的影像由谁授权？
